=== TSTRQXF -- M5-2b1: the write-out fault tests ===
  PASS: the client is UNAUTHORISED (TESTAUTH FCTN=1 == 0)
  PASS: QUERY answers (the STC is up)
  before: state=0 inflight=0 reaped=0
  PASS: the slot is FREE at entry (no other client mid-request)
 
--- (A) unreadable ubuf: the IN direction (pre-existing) ---
  PASS: found an address this client cannot read
  probe address = 00100000 (read faults from the client's own key)
  bad-ubuf request: try rc=000C4000
  PASS: the request faulted rather than completing on a bad pointer
  the fault is S0C4 (a protection or translation exception)
  PASS: the fault was CAUGHT (ESTAE created) -- no dump, client alive
  PASS: the transport still answers after the (A) fault
  after:  state=4 inflight=1 reaped=0
  FINDING: slot CLAIMED (claimed, never published), inflight LEAKED (b3 predicts CLAIMED=4 / stuck at 1)
  PASS: UNSTAGE accepted after (A)
  PASS: QUERY answers after UNSTAGE
  after UNSTAGE: state=0 inflight=0 reaped=0
  PASS: the slot is FREE
  the in-flight count came back clean
 
--- (B) key-0 non-fetch-protected ubuf: the OUT direction ---
  chase CVT    -> 0001D048
  chase SCVT   -> 0001D510
